QuestionStmt.S: If $A = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\theta & \sin\theta & 0 \\ -\sin\theta & \cos\theta & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$, where $A_{21}, A_{22}, A_{23}$ are cofactors of $a_{21}, a_{22}, a_{23}$ respectively, then the value of $a_{21}A_{21} + a_{22}A_{22} + a_{23}A_{23} =$

Solution.S:
$$A = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\theta & \sin\theta & 0 \\ -\sin\theta & \cos\theta & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \end{bmatrix}$$

$$A_{21} = (-1)^{2+1} M_{21} = (-1)^3 \begin{vmatrix} \sin\theta & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = -\sin\theta$$

$$A_{22} = (-1)^{2+2} M_{22} = (-1)^4 \begin{vmatrix} \cos\theta & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \cos\theta$$

$$A_{23} = (-1)^{2+3} M_{23} = (-1)^{5} \begin{vmatrix} \cos\theta & \sin\theta \\ 0 & 0 \end{vmatrix} = 0$$

$$\therefore a_{21}A_{21} + a_{22}A_{22} + a_{23}A_{23} = (-\sin\theta)(-\sin\theta) + (\cos\theta)(\cos\theta) + 0 = \sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta = 1$$
